RIDING & ANALYSIS
• Lean angle and smoothness score analyzed after every ride
• Chicken strips: visualize unused tire grip margin on your tires
• Elevation profile and max lean angle left/right

TIRES LIKE NOWHERE ELSE
• Complete lifecycle: wear by mileage AND age, DOT code decoded
• Target pressure, readings and automatic replacement reminders
• Front and rear tires tracked separately

MOTORCYCLE-SPECIFIC MAINTENANCE
• Chain maintenance driven by actual mileage: lubrication, tension, kit
• Fork, brakes, oil change tracking with smart reminders
• Pre-ride safety check-list that knows your bike
• Complete service log, exportable

NATIVE FRENCH COMPLIANCE
• Motorcycle MOT with current regulations
• ZFE and Crit'Air stickers: know where you can ride
• Deadlines: insurance, MOT, manufacturer recalls

TRIPS, LOG & CIRCUIT
• GPS recording, stats and Ride Mode readable while riding

FREE, WITH CYLABIKE+ OPTION

results.description:
RideKeep is the simple, private maintenance and expense log built for motorcycle riders. Track chain lubes, oil changes, tyres, brake pads, inspections, insurance and fuel — by mileage or by date — and get reminded before anything is due. Everything stays on your phone. No account, no cloud.

WHY RIDERS USE RIDEKEEP
• Chain lube, oil and service reminders that trigger by distance OR time — whichever comes first
• A complete service history you can hand to a buyer when you sell
• Log every expense and see exactly what your bike costs per month and year
• Mileage tracking with a clean history chart
• Ready-made maintenance templates tuned for motorcycles
• Works 100% offline — your bike's data never leaves your phone

STAY ON TOP OF MAINTENANCE
Add your bike, set your current mileage, and RideKeep shows what's coming up: chain lube in 300 km, oil change in two weeks, inspection next month. Mark a job done and the next interval is scheduled automatically.

SELL WITH CONFIDENCE
A full service history is worth real money at resale. RideKeep turns every logged job into a clean PDF report — bike details plus the complete maintenance timeline — that you can show a buyer or keep for your records. (Premium)

TRACK EVERY COST
Fuel, parts, labour, insurance, inspection — log it once and RideKeep totals your spending by month and year, so you always know the true cost of riding.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-up. No servers. No ads. No tracking. Everything you enter is stored only on your device.

FREE VS PREMIUM
Free includes 1 motorcycle, 2 active reminders, and last-30-days charts.
Premium unlocks unlimited bikes, unlimited reminders, all-time charts, the PDF service-history report, and receipt photos.

Premium is available as an auto-renewing subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase, with a free trial on the annual plan. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account, and you can manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://ismetguler.github.io/ridekeep-privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Ride more. Wrench smarter. Keep every service in your pocket.

Your motorcycle deserves better than a notes app.

Revvo is the private maintenance diary for motorcyclists who want control without complexity. No account. No subscription. No cloud you don't own.

EVERY JOB. EVERY BIKE.
Add all your bikes — road, classic, scooter, electric. Log every service with date, mileage and cost. Oil, brakes, tyres, chain — each entry in seconds, not minutes.

NEVER MISS AN ITV, TÜV OR MOT AGAIN
Built for European riders from day one. Set reminders by date or mileage: ITV (Spain), TÜV (Germany), CT (France), Revisione (Italy), MOT (UK). Revvo calculates the interval automatically and alerts you 30 days before the deadline.

30-SECOND LOG ENTRIES
Tap to add a service. Select type, enter mileage and cost, add notes if you want. Done. Oil change and air filter in the same entry — because real service sessions don't change one thing at a time.

FUEL TRACKING THAT MAKES SENSE
Log every fill-up. Revvo calculates your average consumption automatically. Spot the moment something changes.

YOUR DATA. YOUR RULES.
Revvo works fully offline. Sync via iCloud — no data ever passes through our servers. Export your full bike history as PDF whenever you want. Useful the day you sell.

REVVO PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE
Unlimited bikes · iCloud sync · PDF export · Country-specific inspection reminders
One payment. Yours forever.

Available in English, Spanish, German and French.

results.description:
Your motorcycle deserves better than a crumpled receipt in the glovebox and a vague memory of "sometime last summer." Garage Log is the maintenance tracker for riders who love their bikes more than they love spreadsheets.
Log oil changes, transmission fluid, primary oil, air filters, spark plugs, chain tension, brake fluid, coolant, and tires — without summoning a CPA. Track multiple bikes, because we know. You have a problem. We're not here to judge.
What's inside:
• The Garage — All your bikes in one place, each with a live health check. Green means ride. Amber means soon. Red means you've been ignoring it and you know it.
• Smart Service Tracking — Every standard service item, tracked by miles AND time. Because oil doesn't care that you only rode twice last year.
• Fuel & MPG — Log every fill-up, watch your MPG, and finally have a real number to argue with at bike night. Partial fill-ups supported, because gas stations are chaotic.
• Photo Attachments — Snap a pic of the worn-out plug, the shredded filter, or the receipt your spouse is definitely not going to see. Up to 8 photos per service.
• Upcoming Service Reminders — Push notifications that gently nudge you before your top end becomes a science experiment.
• Full Service History — A beautiful timeline of everything you've done, so when you sell the bike you can prove you're not a monster.
No subscriptions. No ads. No "premium tier" to unlock the chain lube reminder. Just you, your wrench, and a logbook that finally keeps up.
Ride more. Forget less. Wrench smarter.

Added support for Cars/Trucks

MotoMainte is an app that helps you easily record and manage your motorcycle maintenance history.

"When was my last oil change?"
"How many kilometers ago did I clean the chain?"
"When is my next maintenance due?"

MotoMainte helps you keep track of your motorcycle maintenance.

Record not only the service date and odometer reading, but also expenses, notes, and photos. You can review your complete maintenance history and maintenance costs at any time.

You can also set maintenance intervals by mileage or days for each maintenance item, making it easy to know when your next service is due.

**Main Features**

**Vehicle Management**

* Manage multiple motorcycles
* Register vehicle photos
* Track odometer readings
* Store owner's manuals (Web / PDF)

**Maintenance Management**

* Oil changes
* Chain cleaning
* Tire replacement
* Brake maintenance
* Other maintenance records

**Maintenance History**

* Record service dates and mileage
* Record expenses
* Save notes
* Attach photos
* View maintenance history
* Duplicate previous records to create new maintenance entries

**Maintenance Schedule**

* Manage by mileage or days
* Check upcoming maintenance
* View elapsed mileage and days since the previous service
* Receive maintenance reminders

**Customization**

* Add, edit, and delete maintenance items
* Customize icons and colors
* Customize displayed information

Whether you commute, ride on weekends, or enjoy touring, MotoMainte helps you keep your motorcycle maintenance organized.

*Maintenance intervals vary depending on the manufacturer, model, and riding conditions. Please configure them appropriately for your vehicle.*

results.description:
With Motorapp, drivers have a motorcycle or car app at their fingertips that helps them manage preventive vehicle maintenance, calculate fuel costs, keep their vehicles up to date, and save money.

WHEN TO DO MY VEHICLE MAINTENANCE
When you add a vehicle, Motorapp automatically creates all the maintenance tasks and repairs you should perform on your car. It shows how many kilometers or how much time should pass between services. These maintenance tasks and repairs are generated automatically based on averages for vehicles similar to yours, using information taken from their respective owner’s manuals and repair manuals.

MAINTENANCE & SERVICE LOG
Oil changes, brake checks, tires, filters, spark plug replacement, general inspections—all of these services can be easily viewed in this vehicle app as a maintenance calendar. When the driver records a maintenance task or repair, the app indicates the next time that service or repair should be performed. The driver can also enter expenses and completed services, making it a very useful tool to view the full maintenance history of the vehicle.

REMINDERS
Motorapp also helps manage vehicle reminders for regular services and expenses such as tracking oil changes, inspections, tires, fines, and more. Reminders can be scheduled by kilometers or date. The app sends periodic notifications indicating which services are due for your motorcycle, car, or any other type of vehicle.

CLOUD-BASED
Motorapp is fully cloud-based, so you can sync across multiple devices and never lose your vehicle data. Syncing is automatic, so you don’t have to worry and can keep control of your vehicle from anywhere. You can also use the web interface to track your vehicle on your computer or tablet.

PRODUCT & TUTORIAL SEARCH
We help by automatically finding products and spare parts for maintenance and services such as oil changes, brake fluid changes, filter replacements, spark plug replacements, tires, or drive chain replacements. When you create a vehicle, the app automatically generates the list of replacement parts and possible repairs for that vehicle.
We also help by automatically finding repair tutorials for your car and vehicle learning manuals.

VEHICLE EXPENSE TRACKING
We help you track fuel, refueling/charges, maintenance, expenses (fines and financing), and income. Motorapp is a personal finance manager for your car, motorcycle, bus, or truck. Motorapp gives the driver full control over expenses. You can record financing, insurance, fines, tolls, and other costs.

MULTIPLE VEHICLES
Managing multiple vehicles and calculating fuel costs is now much easier, with fuel reports and maintenance reports. You can manage your motorcycle, your car, or any other vehicle with ease. And if you have more than one vehicle, you can manage them all in a single app.

Moto Shed is a motorcycle maintenance tracker and service log built for riders who want to organize their motorcycle garage, track repairs, log fuel, and never miss critical maintenance. It also works great for tracking cars, trucks, and other vehicles in your garage.

Increase your resale value, stay ahead of maintenance, and generate a professional service history in seconds. Moto Shed is a clean, ad-free maintenance app designed for riders and vehicle owners who want complete control of their service records, parts, and ownership costs.

Track maintenance, fuel usage, upgrades, and reminders for every motorcycle and vehicle you own.

Motorcycle Maintenance and Service Logging
Record oil changes, tire replacements, valve adjustments, chain service, repairs, upgrades, and parts. Create a complete service history with mileage, parts, labor, and detailed notes so you always know exactly what has been done to your motorcycle, car, truck, or other vehicle.

Fuel and Mileage Tracking
Log fuel fill-ups and fuel costs while tracking long-term mileage and fuel economy trends. Understand how your riding and driving habits affect fuel usage and ownership costs.

Smart Maintenance Reminders
Never forget important service again. Set reminders for oil changes, tire replacement, valve checks, belts, chain maintenance, inspections, insurance, and registration. Alerts can be based on time, mileage, or both. You can also create fully custom maintenance items for any vehicle.

Custom Maintenance Tracking
Track anything you want, not just predefined service items. Create custom repairs, upgrades, inspections, modifications, or recurring maintenance tasks tailored to your motorcycle, car, truck, or project vehicle.

VIN Recall Monitoring
Enter your motorcycle VIN to receive automatic NHTSA recall alerts and safety notifications so you stay informed about manufacturer recalls that may affect your bike.

Cost and Ownership Tracking
Moto Shed automatically tracks parts, labor, fuel, and repairs so you can understand the true cost of owning your motorcycle and other vehicles over time.

Garage Organization
Store everything related to your vehicles in one place including photos, part numbers, owner manuals, service notes, and documentation.

Professional Sales Report
Generate a clean PDF service history report when selling your motorcycle or vehicle. A detailed maintenance record helps build buyer confidence and can increase resale value.

Full Data Control
Export your service history via CSV. Backup and restore your garage using JSON when switching devices so your data always stays under your control.

Flexible and Personalized
Customize service intervals, categories, maintenance items, reminders, and alerts to match your motorcycle, vehicle, and maintenance habits. Choose from multiple themes and organize your garage the way you prefer.

Built for Every Garage
Moto Shed works for sport bikes, cruisers, touring motorcycles, dirt bikes, scooters, electric motorcycles, cars, trucks, SUVs, and project vehicles.

Global Support
Moto Shed supports miles or kilometers, multiple currencies, and 10 languages including English, Spanish, Hindi, Chinese, Indonesian, Japanese, French, German, Vietnamese, and Portuguese.

Keep your maintenance history organized, track ownership costs, and make sure your bikes and vehicles always run their best with Moto Shed.
